title: Level query encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $y$ and a natural number $j$, write $x$ for the first component of the decoded pair represented by $y$. The level query encoding pairs the encoding of $x$ together with a string of $vwid(A,a,|x|)$ true bits, and the suffix of the second component of the decoded pair beginning at position $3vwid(A,a,|x|)j$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet
